## ⚠️ IMPORTANT - READ FIRST ⚠️

**For severe vulnerabilities that could be exploited:**
Please DO NOT create a public issue. Instead:
1. Go to https://github.com/wjdavis5/BrutePy/security/advisories/new
2. Create a private security advisory
3. We will respond within 7 days

**For minor security concerns, you may use this template:**
